## Goods Receipt (GR)

The receiving record for one delivery against one PO. Each line snapshots `qtyOrdered` at posting time (a receipt is an audit document — it keeps saying what was ordered then, even if the PO changes later) next to `qtyReceived`; per-line and overall match states derive from the pair. Multiple receipts accumulate against one PO (partial receiving).

ReceiveGoodsCommand is the single writer that posts a draft receipt: it flips the PO to received / partially-received and moves the received value from the budget's `committed` to `actual`. Over-receipt is allowed but demands a line note, and never moves more than the ordered value through the budget.

### Example

Goods Receipt · Aug 1 (posted): 55/55 monitors against PO-2026-0038, fully matched.

### Non-goals

No inventory or stock management — arrival is recorded here, stock lives in the existing Inventory concepts. No invoice matching (v1.1, three-way).
